# DentalSurgeryNewYork.com
# https://dentalsurgerynewyork.com
# Independent oral surgery reference for New York City patients.

## Purpose
DentalSurgeryNewYork.com is an editorially independent patient guidance platform for oral surgery decisions in New York City. It does not represent any dental practice, does not accept clinical endorsements, and does not facilitate patient referrals. Its purpose is to improve decision clarity in a category where procedure framing, provider positioning, and pricing logic are frequently difficult for patients to interpret.

## Editorial Independence
The site is governed by a published independence policy and commercialization posture. Partner practice placements are fixed-fee, fully disclosed, and carry no editorial influence. No clinical claims are made. No patient data is collected.

- /procedures/oral-surgery-sedation — Sedation types, credentials, and cost structure
- /procedures/emergency-oral-surgery — Emergency situations: ER vs oral surgeon

## Content Policy
All content on this site is informational. It does not constitute clinical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation. Patients should consult qualified providers for individual assessments.

## Commercial Policy
Partner practice placements are available on a fixed-fee, fully-disclosed basis. No pay-per-lead. No clinical endorsement. No editorial control sold. See /partners for current program details.
